system_prompt.content:
TASK: Act like a specific patient, and fill a questionnaire after a counseling session.

The specific patient has the following characters:
{character}.

The session conversation is as follows:
{conversation}

Based on the above information, finish the following questionnaire from the perspective of the patient ([Client]). For each query, provide a concise response that begins with 'I would rate a ' followed by a numerical rating and a clear, single-sentence explanation.
system_prompt.questionnaire description: Below is a list of statements and questions about experiences people might have with their therapy or therapist. Think about your experience in therapy, and decide which category best describes your own experience.

queries.content: As a result of these sessions I am clearer as to how I might be able to change.
What I am doing in therapy gives me new ways of looking at my problem.
I believe the therapist likes me.
The therapist and I collaborate on setting goals for my therapy.
The therapist and I respect each other.
The therapist and I are working towards mutually agreed upon goals.
I feel that the therapist appreciates me.
The therapist and I agree on what is important for me to work on.
I feel the therapist cares about me even when I do things that he/she does not approve of.
I feel that the things I do in therapy will help me to accomplish the changes that I want.
The therapist and I have established a good understanding of the kind of changes that would be good for me.
I believe the way we are working with my problem is correct.
